purpose: One-time recovery manifest for production release tags that were not created historically.

releases.summary:
Release v2.16.0 — production baseline and version synchronization

- Recorded the production deployment state after v2.15.4.
- Synchronized the addon/package version to 2.16.0.
- No functional source-code changes were included relative to v2.15.4.

Release v2.17.0 — catalog delegation and release-catalog improvements

- Added the catalog-to-metadata delegation architecture for BingeCat.
- Removed the legacy v4 resolver and simplified resolver routing.
- Added seasonal continuation, upcoming-episode, and season-recovery improvements.
- Added regression coverage for catalog and BingeCat delegation behavior.
- Retained the addon as the release/airing catalog source while external metadata remains delegated.

Release v2.18.0 — catalog-only Bingecat delegation and identity mapping

- Finalized the catalog-only production architecture with detailed metadata delegated to BingeCat.
- Added MAL/AniList to IMDb/TMDB/TVDB compatibility mapping, including later-season original/prequel resolution and base-name fallbacks.
- Retired public metadata routes from the production resolver.
- Updated Vercel routing, documentation, and regression coverage for the delegated architecture.
- Preserved dynamic seasonal catalog generation and airing/upcoming catalog behavior.
